[1/4] Plan prefab instance links with revert/apply, persisted through prefab and scene snapshots

impact_assessment.why: Inserted prefabs are detached copies: later prefab edits cannot reach instances, and instance overrides are indistinguishable from authored nodes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every single-root insertion carries a stable prefab/instance link, AI clients see it in the editor document, and revert/apply actions make prefab workflows reversible and repeatable.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prefab, scene-snapshot and editor schema bumps; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock unchanged; state: undo snapshots, saved scenes and rollback on failed library writes must preserve links.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Accept prior prefab/snapshot versions, keep links on Node in snapshots, test revert/apply/undo/save paths, and run the full gate cycle.

[1/3] Plan local-axis rotate and scale gizmos with previews, snapping and one transform action per drag

impact_assessment.why: The viewport only translates; Unity/Unreal-style authoring needs rotate and scale handles for direct manipulation.
impact_assessment.benefits: W/E/R transform modes, local-axis rotation and scale previews, Ctrl/Cmd snapping (15 degrees / 0.1 scale), and one validated transform action plus one undo entry per drag.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: the existing gizmo drag state must arbitrate with camera orbit; state: preview world matrices must restore on cancel.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extend the existing gizmo drag lifecycle, derive local quaternion/scale in app.js, add static tests and node --check, then run the full gate cycle.

[1/2] Plan a world/local-space toggle for viewport translation with keyboard and console controls

impact_assessment.why: Translate handles are world-axis only; Unity/Unreal-style placement also needs local-axis movement for rotated parents.
impact_assessment.benefits: A Space toggle and X shortcut switch translate handles between world and local axes, while rotate/scale stay local and every drag remains one transform action.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: existing drag state is cancelled on toggle; state: no persistence needed.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the mode-aware gizmo basis, add static tests, run node --check and the full gate cycle.

[1/2] Plan a prefab_instances summary in the editor document with schema 19

impact_assessment.why: AI clients must scan every node to find prefab instances; a derived summary makes discovery and automation direct.
impact_assessment.benefits: One deterministic list of root id, prefab name and instance prefix, updated with every editor document, plus schema and console discovery.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema bump to 19; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: derived from node links, no new persistence.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive the list from prefab_link nodes, add document tests, and run the full gate cycle.

[1/2] Plan atomic batch support for revert_prefab with one-undo coverage

impact_assessment.why: AI clients can already batch scene edits, but prefab recovery had to be a separate undo step, breaking atomic authoring scripts.
impact_assessment.benefits: revert_prefab joins the batch allowlist, so recovery can be combined with transforms or property edits under one undo entry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema bump to 20; dependency: none; concurrency: batch re-enters the editor lock as today; state: nested history must remain one entry.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse the existing batch dispatch and _batch_depth path, add an undo regression test, and run the full gate cycle.

[1/1] Add prefab-instance badges and an instance count to the console hierarchy

impact_assessment.why: Linked prefab roots are visible in the inspector but indistinguishable in the hierarchy list, unlike Unity/Unreal prefab markers.
impact_assessment.benefits: Hierarchy rows show prefab name and instance prefix, filters match them, and the status line reports the instance count.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no API or schema change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: display-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Derive badges from prefab_link, add static assertions, run node --check and the full gate cycle.
